info.title: ListPlus agent API
info.summary: Check, complete and find B2B contacts and companies.
info.description: Check contact records for errors (free), size markets (free), find people and leads, fill missing fields (paid per hit), and work on a workspace's lists. Every answer carries `options` (next steps with prices), `tell_your_user` and `account`. A paid action called with `estimate: true` answers its price and runs nothing. The manual: https://listplus.ai/a — a key: https://listplus.ai/app/agents

post.description: FREE — Use first when you are unsure what ListPlus offers, what something costs or how much budget is left. what ListPlus can do for you: every action, the fields we can fill with their price per record, the free limits, and (with a key) your balance and day budget. With `guide`: one chapter of the manual instead (prices, search, lists, setup, rules, limits, examples).

guide.description: One chapter of the manual as text instead of the overview; `all` = the whole manual

post.description: FREE with a key (rate-limited) — Use when your user names a person, or a role at a company, and wants to know who that is: title, company, LinkedIn profile. find a person: name, job title, company, location, LinkedIn profile, how sure. Give first_name + last_name + company (or domain), a LinkedIn URL, a work e-mail, or a question in `query` ("CFO of Tink in Berlin"). No e-mail or phone in the answer — those are enrich_records.

domain.description: The company's domain, e.g. acme.com (more exact than the name)

post.description: FREE (up to 25 records without a key, 1000 with one) — Use when your user has contact or company records (a CSV, a CRM export, pasted rows) and wants to know what is wrong with them. check contact records for errors with 100+ checks: typos in e-mail domains, role mailboxes (office@), duplicates and near-duplicates, phone codes that do not fit the country, LinkedIn status text in names, placeholders … Returns findings per record with proposed fixes. Nothing is stored or changed.

records.description: Records as JSON objects. Any key names (e.g. first_name, last_name, email, company_name, domain, linkedin_profile_url, job_title, phone, country, city — or Vorname, Firma, Mail …); the answer says how each key was read.

categories.description: Only these areas (any other value is an error)

ai.description: Also run the AI checks (fake names, a person's name as company, department instead of job title, city vs country) — PAID by use, needs a key; never above the `max` this check names in its `options` when called without `ai` (call it so first)

post.description: PAID (needs a key) — Use when records miss a work e-mail, a mobile number, a job title, a LinkedIn profile or company data. per record from a name + company: work e-mail ≈2.39, at most 9 credits; mobile ≈3.84, at most 12; job title ≈1.41, at most 13.5. Charged per hit for e-mail and phone. Use estimate:true first for the exact price of YOUR records (free, no key). Fills fields of contact records (work e-mail, mobile, job title, LinkedIn profile, company, domain, industry, size, place). Send records for a direct result without creating a list, or list_id and record_ids to update shared rows in place. Waits up to 25 s and returns a job_id to poll (get_job) for longer lookups.

records.description: Records as JSON objects. Any key names (e.g. first_name, last_name, email, company_name, domain, linkedin_profile_url, job_title, phone, country, city — or Vorname, Firma, Mail …); the answer says how each key was read.

post.description: PAID (needs a key) — Use when your user wants new leads: people by role, seniority, industry, place or company. 2 credits per page of up to 25 people, only for pages the database counts (a repeat within 30 days and an empty result cost nothing). Finds people in the B2B contact database by job title, seniority, department, place, industry, company size or company. The people go into a list in ListPlus (name, job title, company, domain, LinkedIn, place — no e-mail or phone: those are enrich_records, priced in `options`). Up to 4 pages per call, a cursor for the next ones (20 pages deep). Exact values from search_options; estimate:true shows the filters as understood and the price (free, no key).

post.description: FREE (key, Set up) to set up — Use when a list needs a new column: a score, a label, a lookup, a formula or an AI column. plain, select, formula, rule-based score / label, lookup, in_list and job_change columns cost nothing (Edit on the list). A hubspot column asks the workspace's HubSpot and is PAID: 1 credit per request of up to 100 different values, for the first run and for records that come later. AI criteria in a score and ai_text columns are PAID: 0.02 credits per AI answer (unique values once), Full on the list; their first run costs at most the list's records × that and counts on this connection's day budget, later records run under the list's own day limit. Tell your user the price before you add a paid column. Up to 10 columns per call; call describe_setup first for the fields a rule may use.

post.description: FREE (key, Set up) to set up — Use when something should happen by itself whenever a record arrives, changes or meets a condition. a rule (trigger) of a list: when a record is new / changed / meets the conditions, set a status (a new name is created), add a tag, hide it (it leaves the normal flow: no checks, rules, enrichment or sync — restorable), hand it to an EXISTING pipeline (pipelines are made by a person in the app), or ENRICH it — PAID per hit, at most budget_per_record credits per record, on THIS connection's day budget (an empty day makes the rule wait, never overspend). Active at once unless activate: false — set an enrich rule up paused until your user agreed to the budget. include_existing runs it once for the records already in the list. Status, tag and hide need Edit on the list; a pipeline the pipeline's share; enrich Full. Call describe_setup first for the fields and operators.
